title: Predicted probability histogram
caption: Twenty fixed 0.05-wide bins partition all 2,000 saved scores. The dashed line is the frozen 0.50 threshold. Scores cluster at the low and high ends; their distribution does not establish 2026 calibration.

title: Historical operational rates versus 2026 predicted rate
caption: Observed operational positive rates are 48.95% (2023), 53.40% (2024) and 49.15% (2025); the 2026 predicted positive rate is 51.30%. Each denominator is the same 2,000 games. The 2026 bar is a model output, not an observed sale participation rate; this is not outcome evaluation.

title: Top ten games
caption: Highest-probability games, ranked by saved probability and then ascending AppID for ties. Labels display six decimal places; ranking uses full precision. These are model rankings, not verified sale outcomes.

title: Bottom ten games
caption: Lowest-probability games, ranked by saved probability and then ascending AppID for ties. Labels display six decimal places; ranking uses full precision. The horizontal axis is zoomed to 0–0.0105. These are model rankings, not verified sale outcomes.

title: Historical count versus predicted probability
caption: All saved scores are plotted against historical valid pre-cutoff price observation counts. The symlog axis includes zero. Spearman correlation is 0.8925; ties use average ranks. Observation density is associated with scores, without establishing causation or complete provider coverage.

title: Predicted positive rate by observation coverage
caption: Groups partition the original cohort: 0, 1–9, 10–29 and 30+ observations. Tick labels give sample sizes and predicted positive (Pos) / operational-zero (Zero) counts. Rates are 0.00%, 1.19%, 25.08% and 84.54%; they are prediction rates, not actual sale participation rates.

title: Probability distribution by observation coverage
caption: Boxes show the 25th–75th percentiles; horizontal lines show medians, diamonds show means, and whiskers show full minimum–maximum ranges. The dashed line is 0.50. Complete subgroup quantiles accompany the figure. Coverage groups describe available historical observations, not verified sale outcomes.

title: Missingness versus predicted class
caption: Left: missing percentages use predicted-class denominators (974 zeros, 1,026 positives); eight remaining predictors have no missing values in either class. Right: all 336 games with missing predictors are predicted operational zero, alongside 638 complete-vector zeros. Missingness is associated with sparse coverage and predicted class; it is not evidence of verified nonparticipation.
